rendered: The TGA-DTG data show that the organic coating layer on the recovered NMC622 is burned off with a weight loss of ~3.3 wt% loss at ~350 °C[1], and that carbon black (CB) is burned off with a weight loss of ~4.1 wt% loss at ~550 °C[2]. Both components can be removed by calcining in air at 600 °C[3], as stated in the text that accompanies the TGA-DTG curves in the figure.
